caption:
Think you have wandered too far to come back?

The Prophet ﷺ said Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a man who finds the camel he had lost in the desert. However far you went, the way back is still open.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6309 · Grade: Sahih

Say astaghfirullah before you sleep and mean it

#tawbah #istighfar #hadithreels #nightreminder
